generation_mode: 内置 image_gen；每资产独立调用；未用 CLI/API/Python 生成或编辑
limitations: 本记录是画面可见姿势与接触/比例检查，不能证明真实肌肉牵伸、受力、临床适用性或保持时间。
108两帧前膝的位移较小；可见方向为向前，具体厘米和角度未据生成图量化验证。
107为足侧局部近景，手指在顶部部分出框但双手扶墙接触可见；108为腰以下含手的近景。
109 s01原单图经审后复用；原图面部与三参考一致性的判断为视觉检查。

discarded_candidates.reason: 首输出全身，未满足足侧近景；用内置image_gen调整为最终近景。
discarded_candidates.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: rehabilitation movement step photograph, one pose only, portrait PNG. Create step 01 starting position for standing knee-to-wall ankle dorsiflexion. Reference images 1–3 fix woman identity, black ponytail, age, skin, white short sleeve shirt, dark charcoal long trousers, soft studio photography, grey-blue seamless studio floor and grey-blue wall. Use a clean TRUE SIDE VIEW medium close framing from lower chest through both complete bare feet, showing hands on wall, hips, front knee, ankle and heel clearly. Woman faces RIGHT toward a vertical grey-blue wall at right edge. Both palms lightly touch wall. Testing leg is nearest camera, its foot points right straight toward wall, entire bare sole and heel flat on floor, toes about 12 cm from wall. Small staggered stance, rear leg farther left for balance. STARTING position: front testing shin almost vertical, knee above ankle, slight knee flexion, knee well separated from wall. Natural hip and knee anatomy. Whole toes and heel visible. Reference 4 is action reference only; change to the specified ankle close framing and bare feet, not its deep endpoint. No words, numbers, arrows, logos, borders, collage, extra equipment. Fixed camera, natural body proportions.

entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: rehabilitation ankle movement step 01 photograph. EDIT the supplied image: change ONLY the framing to a much closer TRUE SIDE VIEW from her waist to floor, making front knee, front ankle and whole front foot large and clear. Crop out head and shoulders. Include both complete bare feet and entire knees, waist and hands touching wall may appear at top right. Do not change the starting pose: testing shin almost upright, front knee above ankle, testing foot points right toward wall, full front heel and sole touch floor; small stagger stance, rear foot at left. Preserve identical foot locations, wall and floor, white short-sleeve shirt hem, charcoal pants, anatomy, grey-blue color, photographic lighting. The image should be about ankle dorsiflexion detail, not a head-to-toe portrait. No text, arrows, numbers, markings or collage.

Both bare heels and whole soles remain firmly touching floor; feet do not slide, no heel raising. Front knee flexes a little more. Keep torso long, neutral back, no stooping, relaxed shoulders. Arms accommodate movement with slightly bent elbows, hands continue light support at same rail location. Keep realistic proportions and unchanged leg bone lengths. One pose only, no words, arrows, numbers, markings, collage or extra objects.
